entries.zh: 褒奖、嘉奖（称赞并加以奖赏）
entries.en: to praise and reward; to commend

entries.zh: 褒贬；称赞与非难并施，评品优劣高下
entries.en: to praise and blame together; to appraise, to judge (praise or disparage)

entries.zh: 褒宠、恩宠嘉奖（对下属盛称其德而加恩遇）
entries.en: to praise and favor an inferior lavishly for his virtue
entries.notes: M栏第二音节声调号T99（污损难辨）；音写 po fiong 完整、四栏词义互证本身清晰。

entries.zh: 褒他、称赞他（伊＝他/她）
entries.en: to praise him/her

entries.zh: 颂扬、称颂
entries.en: to praise; to eulogize

entries.zh: 颂德、歌功颂德
entries.en: to praise virtue; to eulogize merit
entries.notes: M栏音写带[残]标记，据西语释义与R栏 zung te 判为「颂德」。

entries.zh: 称赞、赞许（出言称善以扬人）
entries.en: to praise (by speaking well of); to commend
entries.notes: R栏声调号T99（污损难辨，音系另案处理）；音节与四栏词义互证清晰。

entries.zh: 赞美、称扬；宗教语境亦指赞美天主
entries.en: to praise, to extol; in religious use, to praise God
entries.notes: 西语缩写 comp. 两可（comparación/compañía），取「相比而赞」解；「赞美」本义四栏自明。

entries.zh: 赞叹、惊叹称美
entries.en: to praise with admiration; to extol
entries.notes: M栏首音声调号T99（污损难辨）；音写 chan than 清晰、词义可定。

entries.zh: 赞扬、称扬（播扬其德与美名）
entries.en: to praise and proclaim publicly; to spread the praised one's fame

entries.zh: 羡慕、称羡（敬慕而称道）
entries.en: to admire; to envy

entries.zh: 品评、评定高下；自夸自命（本页「品X」诸条多作自夸解）
entries.en: to rank, to appraise; to boast (self-praise)
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（「alabar se api muy mo」）难复原，据汉字「品」及本页品X系列诸条推断。

entries.zh: 自命高贵、摆架子（夸耀门第头面）
entries.en: to boast of noble birth; to put on airs

entries.zh: 夸耀手面、自夸手段高明
entries.en: to boast of a fine hand; to boast of one's skill or style

entries.zh: 夸气力、自夸膂力过人
entries.en: to boast of one's strength

entries.zh: 夸富、自命富有（品伊富＝自许其富）
entries.en: to boast of being rich

entries.zh: 夸、夸口；夸大其词
entries.en: to boast; to exaggerate

entries.zh: 民歌、民间歌谣（原列于 alabar 词条下，或取颂赞歌谣之义）
entries.en: folk song; song of praise
entries.notes: 西语词头仅 alabar.，与「民歌」义合较松，或谓颂赞之歌谣，姑从四栏并存释义。

entries.zh: 荐举、称荐（感念而荐扬）；荐拔、为亡者诵经超度（荐拔亡魂）
entries.en: to recommend and commend (with gratitude); to offer prayers to deliver the dead
entries.notes: 汉栏标注[疑:拔/技]，据音读 chien poan/chin poa 判作「拔」。

entries.zh: 吹嘘、为人称扬播誉（称美其德、延誉扬名）；今义夸口
entries.en: to praise and boost someone (spread his fame and virtue); hence to boast

entries.zh: 僭称、妄自称大（冒称大人物、僭用名号）
entries.en: to presumptuously style oneself; to claim (falsely) to be a great man

entries.zh: 嘘气呵暖（嘘寒问暖之嘘）；施恩扶助、奖掖提携
entries.en: to breathe warm air upon; hence to favor and to help
entries.notes: M栏音写残损杂乱（「J. Hu..r hey」）不可据，据西语释义与汉字「噓」定释义，兼参吹嘘条。
